verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: Tracing the marked lines across pages 12-16: DC cable (red) and AC earthing (green)/LA (orange) leave the roof near the panels (p12 top) into the 'DC-DB, INVERTER & AC-DB' box (p12 bottom); the AC cable (purple) continues from that box back along the parapet (p13 top), down through a soffit gap (p13 bottom), down the building exterior (p14 top) to the Main Meter/Solar Meter box (p14 bottom, p15 top); separately, the earthing/LA lines (green/orange) run down a side alleyway (p15 bottom) to labeled DC Earth Pit, AC Earth Pit and LA Pit markers at ground level (p16 top). Every colored line starts at a labeled source and ends at a labeled destination with no dangling segments.
verdicts.rationale: The annotated routing is logically continuous with no orphan ends across both the power and earthing/LA paths, but since this is a pre-installation site survey, no cable, conduit, or clips are physically installed yet — the colored lines are proposed routes drawn over existing photos, not built infrastructure, so the 'visible conduit/cable-tie/clipping' part of the question cannot be confirmed.
